bilingual.notes: Dual Language Endorsement adopted by VDOE effective 2026-01-01 (8VAC20-23-321 through -324). Four parallel sections cover Dual Language (English) preK-6 standalone and add-on, plus Dual Language (target language) preK-6 standalone and add-on. Approved teacher preparation program is one path; the alternate path requires specified semester hours plus elementary content / reading-for-educators assessments (English pathway) or 12 SH target language above intermediate level OR a qualifying language assessment (target-language pathway). VDOE introduced the endorsement via the August 7, 2025 webinar 'Introducing the Dual Language Endorsement and Data Management Updates.'

eld.notes: ESL preK-12 endorsement under 8VAC20-23-350. Two paths: (1) approved teacher preparation program in ESL, or (2) 24 semester hours distributed across reading & writing (6), English linguistics (3), cross-cultural education (3), second language acquisition (3), ESL methods grounded in the WIDA English Language Development Standards (3), ESL assessment (3), and electives (3). VDOE requires the Praxis English to Speakers of Other Languages test for the add-on path. Practicum requirement embedded in approved-program path but not separately enumerated in -350; coded null.

history.title: Virginia Seal of Biliteracy authorized (HB 1822, 2015)
history.description: HB 1822 (2015) amended the Code of Virginia to authorize school divisions to award a Seal of Biliteracy on the high-school diplomas of graduates demonstrating proficiency in English and at least one other language. The seal is codified under Va. Code § 22.1-212.1.

history.title: Dual Language Endorsement effective (8VAC20-23-321 et seq.)
history.description: Virginia's first dedicated bilingual licensure track took effect on January 1, 2026, under regulations 8VAC20-23-321 through 324. The endorsement provides four parallel pathways combining English- or target-language preparation with standalone or add-on options.
